cli.help.description: Static security scanner for MCP servers. The code is downloaded and read, never run.
cli.help.input: a GitHub URL, an "npx [-y] <package>" command or a "uvx <package>" command
cli.help.json: print the full result as JSON
cli.help.select: server folder to analyze when the source contains several servers
cli.help.local: analyze a local folder, without any network access
cli.error.one_input: give either an input or --local <folder>, not both
cli.source.local: Local folder (no network access, reputation not checked)
cli.outside.heading: Code outside the tools
cli.outside.counted: This code counts for the verdict, like the code of the tools.
cli.outside.startup: Run at startup (module level, entry point)
cli.tool.nothing_followed: nothing found in what could be followed (incomplete tracking: {reasons})
gap.dict_call: call through a dictionary or a Map that could not be resolved
gap.dynamic_attribute: function name computed with getattr or globals()
gap.unknown_type: method of an object of unknown type
gap.ambiguous: several functions share the same name
cli.title: MCPlain report (static analysis: the code was read, never run)
cli.source.heading: Analyzed source
cli.source.name: Name
cli.candidates.heading: Servers found ({count})
cli.candidates.truncated: The list is cut: there are more servers.
cli.server.heading: Server {path} ({language})
cli.server.name: Name
cli.tools.heading: Tools ({count})
cli.tool.description_dynamic: (description computed at runtime, not readable here)
cli.not_counted.heading: In tests, examples and build scripts (not counted in the verdict)
cli.domains.heading: URLs quoted in the code
cli.domains.not_counted: {count} more URL(s) quoted in tests, examples or build scripts.
cli.sensitive.heading: Sensitive paths mentioned
cli.install.heading: Code run at install time
cli.invisible.heading: Invisible Unicode characters
cli.limits.heading: What could not be fully read
cli.verdict.heading: Verdict
cli.verdict.provisional_note: Provisional: the rules for a red verdict are not available yet.
cli.verdict.disclaimer: Finding nothing does not prove that a server is safe. MCPlain only reads the code it could download.
status.compiled: the server is compiled code, which MCPlain cannot read
status.not_a_server: this does not look like an MCP server
status.error: the analysis stopped on an error
source.requested_package: You asked for this package directly.
source.published_matches_repository: This repository is published as a package, and the package points back to it. The package is what people install, so it was analyzed.
source.published_matches_directory: This folder is published as a package, and the package points back to this repository and folder. The package is what people install, so it was analyzed.
source.no_single_server: There is not exactly one server here, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
source.no_package_manifest: No package name was found, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
source.package_private: The package is marked private and is not published, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
source.package_not_published: No published package has this name, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
source.package_repository_mismatch: A package with this name exists but points to another repository, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
source.package_directory_mismatch: A package with this name exists but points to another folder, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
source.package_without_repository: A package with this name exists but does not say where its code lives, so the GitHub code was analyzed.
note.detected_from_imports: No project file declares an MCP SDK; the server was found from its imports.
note.mostly_documentation: There is no project file and mostly documentation (for example a list of links).
note.no_project_file: There is no project file and no code.
note.no_mcp_sdk: No project file depends on a known MCP SDK.
note.platform_binary_dependencies: The package depends on platform-specific binary packages.
note.native_build_backend: The package builds native compiled code.
note.partially_compiled: Part of this server is compiled and cannot be read.
sensitive.ssh_authorized_keys: SSH authorized keys (who may log in)
reason.capability.network: The server code uses the network.
reason.capability.fs_write: The server code can write or delete files (fs_write).
reason.capability.process_exec: The server code can run system commands (process_exec).
reason.capability.env_read: The server code reads environment variables.
reason.capability.env_read_secret: The server code reads environment variables that look like secrets (env_read_secret).
reason.capability.dynamic_code: The server code can run code built at runtime (dynamic_code).
reason.capability.base64_decode: The server code decodes base64 data.
reason.capability.sensitive_path: The server code mentions a sensitive path such as SSH keys or credentials (sensitive_path).
reason.capability.install_script: The package runs code when it is installed (install_script).
reason.status.multiple_servers: Several servers were found: choose one to get a verdict.
reason.status.unsupported_language: This language cannot be analyzed yet.
reason.nothing_analyzable: No source file could be analyzed.
reason.no_powerful_capability: No powerful capability was found in the server code.
reason.caveat.partially_compiled: Warning: part of the server is compiled and was not read.
reason.caveat.minified_files: Warning: some files are minified, so the report may be less precise.
reason.caveat.parse_errors: Warning: some files have syntax errors and were only partly read.
reason.caveat.skipped_files: Warning: some files were too large and were skipped.
reason.caveat.no_tools_found: Warning: no tool declaration was recognized; tools may be declared in a way MCPlain does not know yet.
reason.caveat.dynamic_descriptions: Warning: some tool descriptions are computed at runtime and could not be read.
reason.caveat.invisible_unicode: Warning: invisible Unicode characters were found in the server code.
rule.provisional.powerful_capability: A powerful capability appears in the server code.
input.too_long: The input is too long (more than {limit} characters).
input.control_characters: The input contains control or invisible characters.
input.unrecognized: Input not recognized. Accepted: https://github.com/owner/repo, https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<ref>/<folder>, npx [-y] <package>[@version], uvx <package>[==version].
input.unsupported_scheme: The "{scheme}" scheme is not accepted. Use an https://github.com/... link.
input.credentials_in_url: Links with a user name or password are not accepted.
input.unexpected_url_parts: The link contains query parameters, which are not accepted.
input.invalid_path: The link path is not valid.
input.path_traversal: The link path contains "..", which is not accepted.
input.missing_repository: The link must name an owner and a repository: https://github.com/owner/repo.
input.invalid_owner: "{owner}" is not a valid GitHub owner name.
input.invalid_repository: "{repository}" is not a valid GitHub repository name.
input.unsupported_github_path: GitHub links of type "{part}" are not accepted. Use the repository link or a /tree/ folder link.
input.missing_reference: The /tree/ link must name a branch, a tag or a commit.
input.invalid_reference: "{reference}" is not a valid branch, tag or folder name.
input.reference_not_found: No branch, tag or commit matches "{reference}".
input.npm_not_registry: "{value}" is not a package from the npm registry. Git links, files and URLs are not accepted.
input.invalid_npm_name: "{name}" is not a valid npm package name.
input.invalid_npm_version: "{version}" is not a valid npm version or tag.
input.version_range_unsupported: Version ranges are not accepted ("{version}"). Give an exact version.
input.invalid_pypi_name: "{name}" is not a valid PyPI package name.
input.invalid_pypi_version: "{version}" is not a valid PyPI version.
input.pypi_extras_unsupported: Extras such as package[extra] are not accepted.
input.invalid_selection: "{path}" is not a valid server folder for --select.
fetch.timeout: The download took too long and was stopped.
fetch.insecure_url: Download refused: the address does not use HTTPS ({url}).
fetch.host_not_allowed: Download refused: "{host}" is not an allowed host.
fetch.bad_redirect: Download refused: {host} sent an invalid redirect.
fetch.github_rate_limited: The GitHub API limit is reached. Wait a little, or set a GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.
fetch.too_large: Download refused: the file is larger than {limit_mb} MB.
fetch.invalid_json: {host} sent an answer that is not valid JSON.
fetch.github_repo_not_found: The GitHub repository {repository} was not found (or it is private).
fetch.github_ref_not_found: No branch, tag or commit named "{reference}" was found.
fetch.npm_not_found: The npm package {package} (version {version}) was not found.
fetch.pypi_not_found: The PyPI package {package} (version {version}) was not found.
fetch.pypi_no_files: The PyPI package {package} has no downloadable file.
fetch.integrity_missing: Download refused: the registry gives no fingerprint to check the file.
fetch.integrity_mismatch: Download refused: the file of {package} does not match the fingerprint given by the registry.
archive.file_too_large: Archive refused: {name} is larger than {limit_mb} MB.
archive.too_large: Archive refused: its content is larger than {limit_mb} MB.
archive.compression_ratio: Archive refused: it is compressed more than {ratio} times, like a zip bomb.
archive.path_traversal: Archive refused: "{name}" tries to leave the extraction folder.
archive.special_file: Archive refused: "{name}" is a special file.
archive.duplicate_entry: Archive refused: a file appears twice.
archive.invalid_layout: Archive refused: its files could not be laid out safely.
analyze.subdir_not_found: The folder "{path}" does not exist in this source.
